_comment: Film 77 clip slots (clip-auftrag-imac.md, 25.11.2026). THE ONE PLACE for clip lengths: 'placeholder' = slot length in seconds while <ROOT>clips/Cn.mp4 is missing (10 s each). When the iMac files are in: put them in <ROOT>clips/, run clips_wav.py (trims each file to [in, out]; null = automatic: first voiced 10-ms frame - 0.15 s .. last voiced + 0.25 s, -40 dBFS; 'cut_pause_after' = cut at the first pause >= 0.15 s after that many seconds of speech), LISTEN to clipwav/Cn.wav, fix in/out by hand if needed (clips-zeiten.txt from the iMac), then build_vo.py -> mix.py -> subs.py (see rebuild.sh). The real length of clipwav/Cn.wav replaces the placeholder and every later time moves with it; no new TTS. cues = subtitle lines <= 34 chars (verified wording from clips-zeiten.txt; wording from clips-final.md (YouTube subtitles + Whisper checked)).

C1.speaker: Demis Hassabis
C1.source: Stanford GSB, A Conversation with Demis Hassabis (2026)
C1.lower_third: ORIGINAL FOOTAGE · DEMIS HASSABIS · CO-FOUNDER, GOOGLE DEEPMIND · STANFORD GSB, 2026
cues: It was literally step one, solve
intelligence, step two, use it to
solve everything else. And people
were quite confused. But we really
meant it.

C2.speaker: Ekin Dogus Cubuk
C2.lower_third: ORIGINAL FOOTAGE · EKIN DOGUS CUBUK · CO-FOUNDER, PERIODIC LABS · LATENT SPACE, 2026
cues: But also we feel like even if,
like, Fable 7 gets really good at,
like, even better than what it is
today, it will still have to run
experiments to get results.

C3.speaker: Terence Tao
C3.lower_third: ORIGINAL FOOTAGE · TERENCE TAO · FIELDS MEDALIST · NUMBERPHILE, 2026
cues: And now we found a shortcut. We
found machines that can get these
proofs for us, and now we're
drowning in proofs, but we're not
getting all the understanding that
we used to get.

C4.speaker: Paul Christiano
C4.lower_third: ORIGINAL FOOTAGE · PAUL CHRISTIANO · ALIGNMENT RESEARCH CENTER · HINTON LECTURES, 2026
cues: So I'd say all of these approaches
are plausible approaches. I don't
want to say any of them are
doomed, but I definitely do want
to say that none of them are on a
trajectory where we can say that's
definitely going to work, or even
that's probably going to work.
